players.product: gas turbines & SMR for data-center power

connects_to.relationship: Doosan Enerbility supplies forgings/materials for NuScale SMR modules and is bidding for module equipment manufacturing

contracts.signal: NuScale's 10-Q states that costs included in its long-lead material (LLM) work in process relate to materials essential to manufacturing the NPM sourced from Doosan Enerbility - raw materials required for heavy forging, steam generator tubes and weld material, plus manufacturing costs to melt, heat treat and machine the raw materials. Long-lead material work in process is shown as $68,553 as of June 30, 2026 and $63,767 as of December 31, 2025 (the saved 10-Q paragraph does not print the unit).
